out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY EMAILED TO PIC. EACH EMPLOYEE MUST SIGN A COPY, AND THESE MUST BE KEPT ONSITE FOR REVIEW FOR EACH INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE CLEAN-UP FORM.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: FORM PROVIDED OVER EMAIL. THIS MUST BE KEPT ONSITE FOR REVIEW.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED SOAP DISPENSER IN LEFT BATHROOM TO BE EMPTY.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. SOAP MUST BE PROVIDED TO EVERY HANDSINK BY JUNE 8TH.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN TWO-DOOR STANDING: MILK AT 44F AND MILK AT 45F. OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR RESIDENTIAL COOLER: HALF AND HALF AT 49F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ABOVE LISTED ITEMS DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED A SQUIRT BOTTLE OF CHEMICAL WITHOUT A LABEL. PIC COULD NOT IDENTIFY BOTTLE OF CHEMICAL TO LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES MUST BE LABELED BY JUNE 8TH. DUCK DONUTS (Inspection Date: 05/28/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE A FOOD THERMOMETER.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. YOU MUST OBTAIN A FOOD THERMOMETER BY JUNE 8TH.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR STAND UP COOLER IN KITCHEN HOLDING MILK AT 43-45F. OBSERVED ONE-DOOR RESIDENTIAL HOLDING HALF AND HALF AT 49F AND READING 46F. THERE WAS NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. BOTH COOLERS MUST BE REPAIRED OR SET TO 33-35F TO HOLD TCS FOODS (SUCH AS MILK)_ AT 41F OR BELOW. YOU MAY NOT USE THESE TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL THEY ARE ADJUSTED OR FIXED. THIS MUST BE COMPLETED BY JUNE 8TH. 2 46.37(a)-(h) - Certified Food Manager, Certification Process Food managers who possess a valid certificate of passing a food safety exam shall obtain the photo identification card from ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided). A copy of the photo identification card can be faxed to the food safety section at (703) 653-9448. Failure to provide a copy of the photo identification card may result in further enforcement action. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION. I WILL PROVIDE A LIST OVER EMAIL TO YOU. THE PERSON PRESENT MUST BE CERTIFIED BY JUNE 8TH.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. OBSERVED QUAT SANITIZER BEING USED AND PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE TEST STRIPS.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit by June 8th.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. OBSERVED NO COVERED TRASH CAN FOR WOMEN IN EITHER BATHROOM. THIS ITEM WAS NOTED IN THE PRE-OCCUPATION INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. YOU MUST PUT A COVERED TRASH CAN IN BOTH BATHROOMS BY JUNE 8TH.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED MULTIPLE LIGHT BULBS INSIDE HOOD TO BE BURNED OUT/NOT WORKING. OBSERVED NO LIGHT IN RIGHT BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. ALL BURNED OUT/NOT WORKING LIGHTS MUST BE REPLACED BY JUNE 8TH.
